PIVOT_SLIME_TEACHER.role: Learn sequence policy over structural pivot tokens and predict top-k activation routes.

PIVOT_SLIME_TEACHER.training_data: Keymaster calibration episodes + prefix trajectories + negative/overflow examples

initial_known_calibration_rules.reason: 25:25 and 250:250 witnesses show pivot IDs are witness-local labels; transferable signal must be structural.
initial_known_calibration_rules.rule: Do not transfer local variable numbers across formulas.
On frozen 250:250 n=8 witness at cap 104^2, local pivots 1 and 2 are first-step overflow while 3..8 fit.
At cap near first-step raw threshold, first-pivot ranking can decide route survival.

keymaster_ranking_contract.diversity_rule: Keep at least one structurally dissimilar alternate in top-k to reduce correlated model error.
keymaster_ranking_contract.proof_lane: Exact fit/overflow and terminal semantics first; model only orders which exact check to attempt.

mission: Turn Keymaster into a persistent pivot navigator calibrated from exact Juxtapose receipts, with Pivot-Slime proposing routes, M2R-PM retaining movement/resource efficiency, and TOPA SPIDER mining hidden relationships. Exact JANUS replay remains sole proof-state authority.
runtime_loop: 2. Feature extractor builds structural pivot candidates for every live variable.
3. M2R-PM retrieves structurally similar exact episodes and aggregate efficiency statistics.
4. Pivot-Slime teacher/student proposes top-k pivot placements and activation prefixes.
5. Keymaster combines model proposal, exact calibration nearest-neighbours, cap margin and diversity into an advisory ranking.
6. Exact JANUS elimination engine verifies the chosen candidate; on failure Keymaster tries the next ranked candidate, without changing the exact verdict.
7. Exact receipt is appended immutably; M2R-PM aggregates update online.
8. Pivot-Slime receives the verified sample for online/periodic retraining; student is distilled/quantized only after holdout checks.
9. TOPA SPIDER periodically weaves relations across accumulated logs and proposes new frozen experiments.
10. Any discovered pattern remains heuristic until independently replayed/replicated; theorem claims require separate proof certificates.

simulation_program.evaluation: Frozen train/validation/holdout split by formula fingerprint, never random trajectory split from the same formula only.
simulation_program.goal: Estimate resource savings before enough real calibration data accumulates.
simulation_program.no_claim_without_data: Savings are unknown until measured on holdout; do not infer from architecture.
simulation_program.primary_measure: Exact checks saved at equal proof correctness.
